leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Buffer from a string using a specified encoding
Convert a Buffer to a string using a different encoding
Manipulate binary data within a Buffer by reading and writing individual bytes
Apply Buffer methods to concatenate multiple Buffer instances into a single Buffer
Integrate Buffer operations with file system functions to read and write binary data
Configure a Buffer to allocate a specific size and fill it with data
Control encoding and decoding processes to handle text data across different character sets
